other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Power consumption modelling applied to a municipal water intake facility (24/7 pumping/water supply process), described as a production process
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
The NN construction was made for the water intake of the 
"Lutskvodokanal" enterprise.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Reference to identifying cyclic changes in the production process of water supply, framing water supply as a continuous production facility
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
The procedure of 
identification of cyclic changes in the production process of 
water supply was applied for this purpose

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Technological process of water supply with pumping stations of 1st and 2nd rise treated as a manufacturing/technological process
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Power consumption in the water supply system 
depends on a number of technological factors that characterize 
the process of raising and supplying water, preparing raised 
water, etc.

one_line: The paper builds and validates a multilayer perceptron neural network on real 2018 data from the "Lutskvodokanal" municipal water intake to model and plan electric power consumption of water supply facilities; no registered Corpus B sector is involved.
